services.desc: will be held at Prospect Park if the weather is appropriate for class. Outdoor classes are located along the esplanade just north of the Le Frak Center, close to the Abraham Lincoln Statue. In the event of inclement weather conditions, outdoor classes may be rescheduled. Our adult classes are 1.5 hours long. They begin with stretching, warm-up and strengthening exercises-which is why it is very important to arrive on time for class and avoid injuries. The training portion of the class focuses on repetition of Capoeira movements to build strength, form and the endurance for the art. Classes end with a roda (Capoeira circle). blurb: Capoeira is an exciting and original workout that comes from the unlikely combination of martial arts, dance, acrobatics and music. It is not only a form of exercise, it is a rich and multidimensional art that teaches culture, language and music. Capoeira is always played in a circle, or roda, where the participants are both the musicians and the players.
